detailed_description: The Gantt Chart Maker is a free online Gantt chart maker for turning a short task list into a visual project timeline or schedule chart. Use it to create Gantt chart online free when you need an easy Gantt chart maker for a quick plan, sprint, campaign, or roadmap snapshot. Add tasks, set start and end dates, update progress percentages, choose a color theme, and preview the result as a horizontal timeline chart. It is useful for sprint planning, marketing campaign schedules, roadmap snapshots, lightweight project briefs, and status visuals where a simple task-duration view is enough. The finished Gantt chart can be downloaded as PNG or SVG for docs, slides, reports, and stakeholder updates. The tool focuses on chart creation; it does not calculate dependencies, resource allocation, critical paths, or live project tracking.
usage_steps: Edit the chart title and choose a color theme.
Click Add Task to create another task row.
Enter each task name, start date, end date, and progress percentage.
Review the live Gantt preview on the right side of the page.
Remove any sample task you do not need.
Download the finished Gantt chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Create a Gantt chart online for a small project plan with task names, dates, and progress bars.
Create a software sprint timeline with planning, development, testing, and release tasks.
Build a marketing campaign schedule chart showing content drafting, review, launch, and reporting.
Turn a construction, event, or product roadmap plan into a simple visual timeline for a stakeholder update.
Export a PNG for a status memo or an SVG for a slide deck.

faqs.question: Can I export the Gantt chart?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current chart can be downloaded as PNG or SVG from the buttons above the editor.

faqs.question: Does this tool track task dependencies?
faqs.answer: No. It visualizes task dates and progress, but it does not calculate dependencies, critical paths, or resource constraints.

faqs.question: Can I use it as an online project timeline maker?
faqs.answer: Yes. It works well for quick project timeline visuals when you need editable task names, start dates, end dates, progress bars, and PNG or SVG export.

faqs.question: Can I create a Gantt chart online without installing software?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create a Gantt chart online in the browser, edit the rows, preview the chart, and export PNG or SVG files without installing a desktop app.

faqs.question: What fields can I edit?
faqs.answer: You can edit the chart title, color theme, task name, start date, end date, and progress percentage for each task.

faqs.question: Is this a project management app?
faqs.answer: No. It is a browser-based chart maker for quick project timeline visuals, not a full project management system.
